apply_w8a8_block_int8_linear: apply w8a8 block int8 linear transformation to input tensor with weight and block size parameters
quantize_per_token_group_int8: quantize input tensor to int8 using per-token-group quantization with specified group size
quantize_per_token_int8: quantize input tensor to int8 using per-token quantization with per-row scaling factors
matmul_w8a8_block_int8: perform w8a8 block int8 matrix multiplication with quantized input and weight tensors and their scales
dequantize_block_int8: dequantize block-wise quantized int8 tensor back to float32 using per-block scaling factors
